narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Members' Desk in Daylight"**

The Club is a private members' desk in warm daylight: a cream and white room, dark umber type, and a little brass where a hand would touch. It is quiet, editorial and discreet. The conversation with the concierge and the ledger of what the member is getting are the store; there is no product-tile grid and no support-chat chrome. Density is low on public pages (96–128px between sections, generous measure) and calm but working on member surfaces, where a three-column desk (filters, conversation, cart) holds everything at once.

Hierarchy comes from type, hairlines and slight tonal steps, not from boxes or shadows. Cormorant Garamond carries every headline and every price numeral, so money reads in the same voice as the brand. Inter does all the interface work. Brass is rare and always means one of three things: the primary action, a selected state, or the member price. There is no photography: where an image would sit, soft moving light does the work (a WebGL molten flow on the landing page, a drifting CSS aurora elsewhere); products are drawn vessels, never photographs of cannabis.

The binding visual standard is the client's Premium Visual Design Implementation Guide together with the brief's look-and-feel section (Cormorant Garamond + Inter). At the user's request the palette later moved from the original dark green-black world to beige and white, and photography was replaced with moving aurora light; this file records the shipped light world.
keyCharacteristics: Light, warm, architectural: cream and white surfaces, dark umber type, about 5% brass.
Hairlines (1px, 12–20% umber) separate everything; shadows appear only on things that float.
Cormorant for display and every price numeral; Inter for interface.
The member ledger: retail struck through, member price in brass Cormorant numerals, bundle price beneath, set identically everywhere a price appears.
Products are authored sand-glass vessel silhouettes on cream plinths; no photography anywhere.
Motion is short ease-out entry; the only flourish is a brass glow on a newly added cart row.

rules.name: The Hardware Rule
rules.body: Brass means action, selection or progress, member value, or the seal. If a brass element is none of these, remove the brass. Target about 5% of any screen; large brass fills are limited to primary buttons, the send buttons and the SMS reply bubble, always with On Brass text.

rules.name: The Priced in Garamond Rule
rules.body: A price the member pays is always a Cormorant numeral. A price they are not paying (retail) is small struck Inter.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels, buttons and headings are sentence case. Tracked uppercase is not part of the system.

rules.name: The Open Section Rule
rules.body: Public sections are open: type, hairline rules and spacing make the hierarchy. Panels are reserved for things the member acts on (plans, summary, cart, drawer).

rules.name: The Float Only Rule
rules.body: At rest, nothing in the page has a shadow. A shadow means the element is over the page and can be dismissed.

dos: **Do** use Club Brass (#8d6b3d) only for action, selection or progress, member value, or the seal; keep it near 5% of the screen.
**Do** set every price the member pays as a Cormorant 600 lining, tabular numeral, and every retail price as small struck Inter.
**Do** use the member ledger (retail struck, member in brass, bundle beneath in Lit Brass) wherever a price appears, at 18, 22 or 30px.
**Do** separate regions with 1px hairlines at 12% umber and outline interactive controls at 20% umber.
**Do** step depth through Canvas, Raised and Raised Two; reserve the Float shadow for drawers, dialogs, the phone and the mobile cart bar.
**Do** set text on brass fills in On Brass (#fffaf2).
**Do** give every control the 2px brass focus outline at 3px offset and a 42% opacity disabled state.
**Do** enter with ease-out in 120–320ms and collapse all motion under reduced motion.
**Do** draw products as vessel silhouettes on tonal plinths, and use moving light (MoltenMetal or Aurora) where an image would sit.
**Do** turn the cart into a floating bar and bottom sheet below 1024px.
donts: **Don't** build a storefront grid of product tiles; products appear as recommendations inside the conversation, in the cart and in the drawer.
**Don't** style the concierge like a SaaS support widget (floating launcher bubble, bot avatars, boxed agent messages); Nora speaks unbubbled beside her avatar.
**Don't** use photographs of cannabis, leaf clip art, smoke, cartoons or people using cannabis.
**Don't** put shadows on cards, panels or buttons at rest.
**Don't** use photography or stock images anywhere; imagery is generated moving light.
**Don't** set prices the member pays in Inter, or retail prices in Cormorant.
**Don't** add tracked-uppercase eyebrows or section markers above headings.
**Don't** add new greys; step text with Muted, Faint, or opacity of the umber text color.
